title: The 5 Most Visited Websites, Ranked (#1 Gets 87 Billion Visits a Month)

scenes.text: The five most visited websites on Earth. Number five only launched at the end of 2022.

scenes.label: ChatGPT · 5.6 billion
scenes.text: Number five: ChatGPT. 5.6 billion visits a month, from a site that didn't exist before late 2022.

scenes.label: Instagram · 7.6 billion
scenes.text: Number four: Instagram. 7.6 billion visits a month, and that only counts browsers, not the app.

scenes.label: Facebook · 11.5 billion
scenes.text: Number three: Facebook. 11.5 billion visits a month, still ahead of every app that was built to replace it.

scenes.label: YouTube · 30.4 billion
scenes.text: Number two: YouTube. 30.4 billion visits a month, nearly three times Facebook.

scenes.label: Google · 86.6 billion
scenes.text: Number one: Google. 86.6 billion visits a month, nearly three times YouTube, and more than ten visits for every person alive.

description:
The five most visited websites in the world, ranked by monthly visits.
Similarweb's August 2026 estimates, counting desktop and mobile browser visits but not app traffic: google.com 86.6 billion, youtube.com 30.4 billion, facebook.com 11.5 billion, instagram.com 7.6 billion and chatgpt.com 5.6 billion. Google alone gets more than ten visits a month for every person on Earth.
Which site do you open first every day?
first_comment: Add app traffic and the order would change: most Instagram and TikTok use never touches a browser. Which would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
